title: Family Group Outside Brick Wall, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken on June 14, 1949, capturing a man standing between two women outdoors against a light-colored brick building. The young woman on the left wears a dark short-sleeved dress with white sandals, while the man wears a collared shirt with rolled sleeves and dark trousers, and the woman on the right wears a white dress with dark strappy heels.
